parent_proposals.insert_text: The [Jung–Pauli dossier](../dossiers/jung-pauli-psychoid.md) compares a historical receiving burden. In 62P (27 May 1953, pp.118–119), Pauli proposes that an adopting discipline must itself undergo the greater transformation; Jung rejects psychology’s absorption into physics in 64J (24 October 1953, p.128). The correspondence supplies a contested comparison, not evidence that this incorporation occurred.
